## Summary / 摘要

<!-- 对用户或维护者有什么变化？ / What changes for users or maintainers? -->

## Scope / 范围

- [ ] Documentation only / 仅文档
- [ ] Runtime behavior / 运行时行为
- [ ] API or event contract / API 或事件契约
- [ ] Security or permissions / 安全或权限
- [ ] Dependency or resource lock / 依赖或资源锁
- [ ] Test or CI coverage / 测试或 CI 覆盖

## Verification / 验证

<!-- 列出准确命令和有意义的结果。 / List exact commands and meaningful results. -->

- [ ] `python scripts/check_docs.py` / 文档检查
- [ ] Electron type-check/lint/tests/build as applicable / 按需执行 Electron 类型检查、lint、测试和构建
- [ ] Python tests/type-check/compile checks as applicable / 按需执行 Python 测试、类型检查和编译检查
- [ ] Manual provider, audio, GPU, or avatar validation described when relevant / 相关时描述服务商、音频、GPU 或虚拟形象的手动验证

## Risk and release notes / 风险与发布说明

<!-- 说明迁移、配置变化、许可证影响、安全影响和已知限制。 / Mention migrations, configuration changes, license implications, security impact, and known limitations. -->

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, logs, databases, caches, model weights, or generated build output are included. / 未包含密钥、个人数据、日志、数据库、缓存、模型权重或构建产物。
- [ ] New or changed contracts have regression tests. / 新增或变更的契约有回归测试。
- [ ] Third-party assets and licenses are documented. / 第三方资源及许可证已记录。
- [ ] Documentation matches the actual supported behavior. / 文档与实际支持行为一致。
